hints.title: Chronologically Appended Timestamp Search
hints.text: Since set timestamps are strictly increasing, store (timestamp, value) pairs in an array per key to enable ordered point lookup.

hints.title: Binary Search for Greatest Preceding Timestamp
hints.text: For a given key and query timestamp, binary search the key array for the largest recorded timestamp less than or equal to the query.

hints.title: TimeMap Operations Blueprint
hints.text: In set(key, value, timestamp): map[key].append((timestamp, value)). In get(key, timestamp): retrieve array. If empty or array[0].time > timestamp return empty string. Else use bisect_right - 1 and return value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Appends to end of chronological list take O(1); binary search retrieves query values in O(log N).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning historical entries linearly takes O(N) per query, timing out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Chronologically appended list takes linear space while enabling fast logarithmic lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Exploiting strictly increasing timestamps to avoid sorting overhead on set.
